title: Mancala: seed-sowing pit capture game
description: 2 players, 14 pits (6 per player + 1 store each). Track zone with counter-per-pit semantics. Sowing mechanic: pick up all seeds from a pit, drop one in each subsequent pit counterclockwise. Capture: if last seed lands in an empty pit on your side, capture that seed plus opposite pit's seeds. Extra turn: if last seed lands in your store. Game ends when one side is empty, remaining seeds go to that side's opponent. Perfect information, no randomness, fully client_verifiable. Demonstrates track zone with multi-step seed distribution — a mechanic unlike any other game in the catalog.
